summary: Metrics: aggregate cost must not go null when one run lacks spend rows
description:
Due 2026-11-06. Follow-up from the PR #30 review.

`GET /api/metrics` returns `usd: null` and `model_calls: null` for the whole range if _any_ run has `cost_status: missing`. Runs from before the spend-log tagging fix (e.g. d4fc7e9e) have no tagged rows, so every unfiltered total would show "n/a" from now on, including on the demo metrics page.

## Do

* Sum `usd` and `model_calls` over runs whose cost is available. Add `runs_missing_cost: <n>`, and set `cost_status` to `partial` when 0 < n < runs.
* Per-run behaviour is unchanged.
* Tests: a mixed range returns a partial sum plus the count; an all-missing range returns null.

## Acceptance

The unfiltered `/api/metrics` returns a number on the current dev DB, with a count of runs that have no cost data.
